hypothesis: The end-to-end pitch-gated TabM direction was very strong in 2020 but reversed in aggregate in 2021. A small row-local context route may isolate a pitch-choice regime whose marginal control direction persists in both source years without using target-season aggregation or labels at inference.

immutable_inputs.game_type: R only; F remains exact parent

candidate_routes: one conjunction of exactly one pressure/count-shape atom and one hand atom
one conjunction of exactly one pressure/count-shape atom and one season-evidence atom
a union of at most three mutually exclusive atoms from one family

constraints.inference_features: official row-local columns plus completed-train pitcher lifetime boundary used to reconstruct current-season n

tie_breakers: maximize min pitcher-cluster 95% CI lower gain

required_each_year: R point gain >= 50 raw score points
source_gate.on_fail: close this route family without reading 2022, 2023, or 2024 challenger predictions
source_gate.on_pass: freeze the exact route expression and implementation hash before generating 2022/2023 challenger predictions
